title: Colonel J Hampden
memorial_details: description: HERE, / IN THE FIELDS OF CHALGROVE / JOHN HAMPDEN, / AFTER AN ABLE AND STRENUOUS / BUT UNSUCCESSFUL RESISTANCE / IN PARLIAMENT / AND BEFORE THE JUDGES OF THE LAND / TO THE MEASURES OF AN ARBITRARY COURT / FIRST TOOK ARMS / ASSEMBLING THE LEVIES OF THE ASSOCIATED COUNTIES / OF BUCKINGHAM AND OXFORD / IN 1642. / WITHIN A FEW PACES OF THIS SPOT / HE RECEIVED THE WOUND OF WHICH HE DIED / WHILE FIGHTING IN DEFENCE / OF THE FREE MONARCHY / AND ANCIENT LIBERTIES OF ENGLAND / JUNE 18. 1643 / IN THE TWO HUNDREDTH YEAR / FROM THAT DAY / THIS STONE WAS RAISED / IN REVERENCE TO HIS NAME.
